description.text: The third Scarlet & Violet set, released on 11 August 2023 with 230 cards: 197 and 33 secret rares. It has the first Tera Pokémon ex of a different type from their usual one, led by a Darkness-type Charizard ex, with Tyranitar, Eiscue and Vespiquen, beside Dragonite ex, Greedent ex, Revavroom ex and Melmetal ex.
